question: How does activation choice affect learned feature computation, functional neuron sharing and FSEC-style geometry?

comparisons.primary: ReLU, GELU and SiLU, all width 50 and 10000 parameters

training.schedule: cosine to zero over exactly 100000 updates

initialization: For each seed, draw full 50x100 W_gate in Uniform(-.1,.1), 100x50 W_out in Uniform(-.15,.15), then independent W_value in Uniform(-.1,.1). Identical role-matched values across architectures/losses, truncated for width 33. SwiGLU has an independent value projection. No activation-specific scaling/tuning.
pairing: Every architecture/objective/initialization sees the same fixed training pool and minibatch sequence. Seeds vary initialization. Loss is a sum of per-network batch/feature means, preserving individual Adam gradient scale.
task_metrics: per-feature MSE conditioned on positive input
coverage with MSE<0.05 and correct unit-probe argmax/gain>=0.25
sharing_metrics: Per-feature/per-neuron diagonal task contributions W_out[j,n]*h_n(e_j), their participation ratios, and coverage relative to width. These are operational sharing/competence indicators, not a universal proof or scalar amount of CiS. ReLU-only binary-code assumptions are not imposed on other activations.

geometry.selection: Before training: six pairs from seeded permutation of all features. After training, before inspecting p: first three eligible pairs in a fixed seeded ordering of all feature pairs for each network. Log overlap/exclusions, no p-based selection. Separate fixed-pair and competence-conditioned cohorts.
geometry.eligibility: Both features have positive-active MSE<0.05, unit self-gain>=0.25 and correct unit-probe argmax
geometry.gated_directions: Concatenate gate and value encoder columns; perturb both preactivation branches. Random directions match norms/cosine in this joint space.
geometry.fit: Original additive superellipse fitter plus PSD tilted quadratic, same as toy-cis-v1; report all flags and invalids
geometry.fine_check: First competence-conditioned pair per network if available, ++ sign, negative pair anchor, encoder and random directions, 81x81

interpretation: Compare held-out task fidelity and functional sharing independently of p. Different p may reflect nonlinear function shape; failures to learn under the fixed optimizer/init are training-regime results. One shared task and three initialization seeds do not establish a general activation ranking or grokking tendency.
stopping_rule: Continue all 18 scalar networks to exactly 100000 updates; no SwiGLU training. Other scalar functions, if requested, will be separately trained cohorts.

continuation.reason: User explicitly abandoned SwiGLU; preserve scalar-network weights, optimizer, scheduler and RNG state.
